archetypes.name: scope-flow
archetypes.rationale: Diff changes SCOPE_ANCHOR_FILE propagation across multiple nested design-review scripts where stale env leakage and terminal gating are high-risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the end-to-end scope-anchor path handoff across plan-review-loop, run-step3-review, SKILL.md retally logic, result env files, and related harnesses. Check that values are only emitted or persisted on the intended terminal statuses, stale exported values cannot leak, parsed output is separated from input fallback, and raw tally stdout is filtered before relay. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: prompt-boundary
archetypes.rationale: Several prompt renderers now wrap untrusted files, redact secrets, escape delimiters, and validate paths, so prompt-injection regressions need specialist scrutiny.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review all changed prompt-construction surfaces that inline untrusted plan, finding, feature, assessor, voter, or subprocess context content. Verify that secret redaction, XML-like escaping, framing prose, size limits, symlink rejection, and path-attribute escaping are consistently applied without treating embedded text as instructions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: ship-cutover
archetypes.rationale: The diff appears to move ship-pr Python to the default path while also changing Python version assumptions and fallback docs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Python ship driver cutover as an integration boundary between /implement orchestration, legacy bash fallback, docs, CI, and tests. Check that state-file semantics, finalize-state writes, exit codes, resume/pre-push handoffs, Python 3.12 requirements, and environment switches remain coherent and backward-compatible where promised. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The changes add or alter many bash harnesses and drivers with strict path, env, stdout, and Bash 3.2 compatibility contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on shell-script correctness in the modified drivers and tests, especially quoting, arrays, stdin preservation, canonical path checks, CR/LF rejection, temp-file handling, and stdout parsing. Look for behavior that passes the new harnesses but fails under macOS Bash 3.2, unusual paths, missing files, or degraded tool states. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: docs-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The diff updates many normative docs and skill instructions that consumers rely on as runtime contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare documentation changes in AGENTS, SECURITY, skill markdown, and repository docs against the actual runtime behavior introduced in scripts and Python. Flag overclaims, stale fallback descriptions, missing security caveats, or instructions that would cause users or orchestrators to run the wrong checks or trust the wrong surface. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
